run_sweep_analysis: run the sweep analysis tool to generate an HTML report with EDF plots and metrics
analyze_sweep_results: analyze hyperparameter sweep results and generate an HTML sweepbook with EDF and metric plots
plot_edf_curves: plot empirical distribution function curves comparing multiple sweep results side by side
filter_sweep_results: apply pre-filters or split-filters to sweep results and plot filtered EDF comparisons
plot_best_worst_models: plot the best or worst performing models and error curves from sweep results
